title: Customers With Total Orders
statement: Write a query joining `customers` and `orders` to return `name, SUM(amount) as total` per customer, ordered by total descending, with ties broken by name ascending.
starter_code:
SELECT c.name, SUM(o.amount) as total
FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON -- TODO
GROUP BY -- TODO
ORDER BY total DESC, -- TODO (tiebreak)
;
hints: JOIN on customer_id = id, then GROUP BY customer name and SUM the amounts
Aman and Bala tie on total (800 each) - break the tie with a secondary ORDER BY on name ascending
